name: Edit Bone
description: Edit mode bone in an armature data-block

props.name: Collections
props.description: Bone Collections that contain this bone

props.name: Parent
props.description: Parent edit bone (in same Armature)

props.name: Roll
props.description: Bone rotation around head-tail axis

props.name: Head
props.description: Location of head end of the bone

props.name: Tail
props.description: Location of tail end of the bone

props.name: Length
props.description: Length of the bone. Changing moves the tail end.

items.name: Armature Defined
items.description: Use display mode from armature (default)

items.name: Octahedral
items.description: Display bones as octahedral shape

items.name: Stick
items.description: Display bones as simple 2D lines with dots

items.name: B-Bone
items.description: Display bones as boxes, showing subdivision and B-Splines

items.name: Envelope
items.description: Display bones as extruded spheres, showing deformation influence volume

items.name: Wire
items.description: Display bones as thin wires, showing subdivision and B-Splines

props.name: Connected
props.description: When bone has a parent, bone's head is stuck to the parent's tail

props.name: Inherit Rotation
props.description: Bone inherits rotation or scale from parent bone

props.name: Multiply Vertex Group with Envelope
props.description: When deforming bone, multiply effects of Vertex Group weights with Envelope influence

props.name: Deform
props.description: Enable Bone to deform geometry

props.name: Inherit Scale
props.description: Specifies how the bone inherits scaling from the parent bone

items.name: Full
items.description: Inherit all effects of parent scaling

items.name: Fix Shear
items.description: Inherit scaling, but remove shearing of the child in the rest orientation

items.name: Aligned
items.description: Rotate non-uniform parent scaling to align with the child, applying parent X scale to child X axis, and so forth

items.name: Average
items.description: Inherit uniform scaling representing the overall change in the volume of the parent

items.name: None
items.description: Completely ignore parent scaling

items.name: None (Legacy)
items.description: Ignore parent scaling without compensating for parent shear. Replicates the effect of disabling the original Inherit Scale checkbox.

props.name: Local Location
props.description: Bone location is set in local space

props.name: Relative Parenting
props.description: Object children will use relative transform, like deform

props.name: Display Wire
props.description: Bone is always displayed in wireframe regardless of viewport shading mode (useful for non-obstructive custom bone shapes)

props.name: Cyclic Offset
props.description: When bone does not have a parent, it receives cyclic offset effects (Deprecated)

props.name: Selectable
props.description: Bone is able to be selected

props.name: Envelope Deform Distance
props.description: Bone deformation distance (for Envelope deform only)

props.name: Envelope Deform Weight
props.description: Bone deformation weight (for Envelope deform only)

props.name: Envelope Head Radius
props.description: Radius of head of bone (for Envelope deform only)

props.name: Envelope Tail Radius
props.description: Radius of tail of bone (for Envelope deform only)

props.name: B-Bone Segments
props.description: Number of subdivisions of bone (for B-Bones only)

props.name: B-Bone Vertex Mapping Mode
props.description: Selects how the vertices are mapped to B-Bone segments based on their position

items.name: Straight
items.description: Fast mapping that is good for most situations, but ignores the rest pose curvature of the B-Bone

items.name: Curved
items.description: Slower mapping that gives better deformation for B-Bones that are sharply curved in rest pose

props.name: B-Bone Display X Width
props.description: B-Bone X size

props.name: B-Bone Display Z Width
props.description: B-Bone Z size

props.name: B-Bone Start Handle Type
props.description: Selects how the start handle of the B-Bone is computed

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Use connected parent and children to compute the handle

items.name: Absolute
items.description: Use the position of the specified bone to compute the handle

items.name: Relative
items.description: Use the offset of the specified bone from rest pose to compute the handle

items.name: Tangent
items.description: Use the orientation of the specified bone to compute the handle, ignoring the location

props.name: B-Bone Start Handle
props.description: Bone that serves as the start handle for the B-Bone curve

props.name: Start Handle Scale
props.description: Multiply B-Bone Scale In channels by the local scale values of the start handle. This is done after the Scale Easing option and isn't affected by it.

props.name: Start Handle Ease
props.description: Multiply the B-Bone Ease In channel by the local Y scale value of the start handle. This is done after the Scale Easing option and isn't affected by it.

props.name: B-Bone End Handle Type
props.description: Selects how the end handle of the B-Bone is computed

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Use connected parent and children to compute the handle

items.name: Absolute
items.description: Use the position of the specified bone to compute the handle

items.name: Relative
items.description: Use the offset of the specified bone from rest pose to compute the handle

items.name: Tangent
items.description: Use the orientation of the specified bone to compute the handle, ignoring the location

props.name: B-Bone End Handle
props.description: Bone that serves as the end handle for the B-Bone curve

props.name: End Handle Scale
props.description: Multiply B-Bone Scale Out channels by the local scale values of the end handle. This is done after the Scale Easing option and isn't affected by it.

props.name: End Handle Ease
props.description: Multiply the B-Bone Ease Out channel by the local Y scale value of the end handle. This is done after the Scale Easing option and isn't affected by it.

props.name: Roll In
props.description: Roll offset for the start of the B-Bone, adjusts twist

props.name: Roll Out
props.description: Roll offset for the end of the B-Bone, adjusts twist

props.name: Inherit End Roll
props.description: Add Roll Out of the Start Handle bone to the Roll In value

props.name: In X
props.description: X-axis handle offset for start of the B-Bone's curve, adjusts curvature

props.name: In Z
props.description: Z-axis handle offset for start of the B-Bone's curve, adjusts curvature

props.name: Out X
props.description: X-axis handle offset for end of the B-Bone's curve, adjusts curvature

props.name: Out Z
props.description: Z-axis handle offset for end of the B-Bone's curve, adjusts curvature

props.name: Ease In
props.description: Length of first Bézier Handle (for B-Bones only)

props.name: Ease Out
props.description: Length of second Bézier Handle (for B-Bones only)

props.name: Scale Easing
props.description: Multiply the final easing values by the Scale In/Out Y factors

props.name: Scale In
props.description: Scale factors for the start of the B-Bone, adjusts thickness (for tapering effects)

props.name: Scale Out
props.description: Scale factors for the end of the B-Bone, adjusts thickness (for tapering effects)

props.name: Hide
props.description: Bone is not visible when in Edit Mode

props.name: Lock
props.description: Bone is not able to be transformed when in Edit Mode

props.name: Edit Bone Matrix
props.description: Matrix combining location and rotation of the bone (head position, direction and roll), in armature space (does not include/support bone's length/size)
